about_the_game:
It's your first day at college after being home-schooled for your entire life, essentially. You have two best friends you've known since childhood, but you should come out of your shell and meet new people. But it's challenging to do that when everyone seems to carry some baggage behind them, and some of them take it out on you. And then it gets worse. Much. Much. Worse.

But maybe. 

Just maybe. You can make it easier for someone out there in the world. If only you knew what's going on...

By Your Hands is an erotic gay furry murder-mystery visual novel created by me and written by Nemo. 

This is the demo of By Your Hands. It currently covers six days for three routes, three days for one route, and one and a half days for another route. The full release is expected to have a lot more content for all five routes. Current features of the game that are present in the demo are:

  • A CG gallery to revisit illustrations from the game.

  • A Music Room that allows you to listen to songs you've heard from the game.

  • A codex that gives extra information about characters and the setting of the game.

The demo has only a fraction of the features of the full release.

Credits and Attributions

Major code assistance done by Shie. GUI done by Hijiri. Soundtrack composed by Brkn Hvn. Additional songs by Haoran. Editing for "Blood Sucking" done by HugeCookie. Code for Inline Coding, Music Room, and Masked Layered Images goes to Feniks. Background images from Pexels, Pixabay, and iStock images.

content_descriptors.notes: This VN includes sexually explicit content of a homosexual male nature. It shows or discusses racism, murder, violence, mental illness, sexual harassment, drug abuse, homophobia, and strong language. This game is intended for audiences 18 or older. Please do not play this VN if you aren't at least 18.

short_description: A murder mystery visual novel where you play a fish-out-of-water college student who must face the best and worst traits animalkind has to offer. Solve the mystery of this school as you develop close bonds, get intimate, and uncover shocking secrets with alluring, yet deeply flawed, ordinary men.
